skills.name: wc3v-build-lookup
skills.description: Find a Warcraft III build order for a race, matchup and skill level from the WC3V library, and explain how to execute it.

skills.name: wc3v-replay-analysis
skills.description: Turn a WC3V replay summary into a coaching critique for a Warcraft III player, using benchmarks measured from a corpus of 192 parsed pro games.

skills.name: wc3v-replay-format
skills.description: Parse or interpret a Warcraft III .w3g replay or a WC3V .wc3v JSON file, including the identity and worker-tracking rules that are easy to get wrong.

skills.name: wc3v-terminology
skills.description: Translate Warcraft III jargon (T2, creeping, teching, expo, harass) into plain language, using WC3V's glossary.
